title: Topology workbench
subtitle: Cross-layer constraints: declare → check → locate → exception → repair → recheck
noAuth: The topology workbench requires sign-in (rulesets/runs are owner-scoped).

rulesets.empty: No rulesets yet. Create one to declare cross-layer constraints (e.g. parcels must cover the admin zone excluding lakes).
rulesets.name: Name
rulesets.tip: Param semantics: tolerance_m is linear meters; *_threshold_m2 is square meters — never interchangeable.

runs.empty: No runs for this ruleset yet.
runs.bindingHint: coverage/aoi/target/connectors must bind complete sources; checked-style roles may carry a scope. Session refs look like ref:…
runs.allUnknown: Note: all rules are blocked/unknown — this must not be read as all-pass.
runs.budgetTruncated: Note: some rules hit budget caps (partial); counts are partial results.
runs.recheckDone: Recheck done: {resolved} resolved / {persisted} persist / new run has {total} findings

findings.empty: No findings for this run (or filters match nothing).
findings.countNote: Total is the full count (not the current page).
findings.stale: Stale locator: source changed ({reason}) — rerun the check.

exception.reasonLabel: Exception reason (required; archived with the anchor)
exception.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. lake is a planned water reserve; the coverage gap is legal
exception.accepted: Exception recorded (processing state only — the detected fact is unchanged).
exception.revoked: Exception revoked; the finding is open again.
exception.note: Exceptions are user decisions; source or rule changes invalidate them (re-validation required).

repair.noCandidates: No deterministic repair for this finding — fix manually in the editor, then recheck.
repair.ownership: This repair needs an ownership choice (who keeps the gap/overlap) — not auto-decided.
repair.committable: Preview committable: approve it in the map edit proposal card (G14 CAS/undo chain inherited).
repair.notCommittable: Preview failed validation (see findings) — adjust and retry.
repair.note: A suggestion is not a fix: commit needs approval; after repair, recheck that evidence is gone.

errors.scopeNotAllowed: This role requires a complete source (partial selections create false gaps) — bind the full dataset.
errors.sourceChanged: Source changed after submission — restart the check.
errors.budget: Over budget cap — narrow the check scope.
errors.region: Region unsupported (antimeridian/polar/too large) — narrow the extent.
